purpose: Execution history of the thin-structure study (scripts/thin_structure_study.py) before its results. An entry here is an execution failure, not an experimental replicate.

attempts_before_any_result.failed_at: first cell (straight, core width 0, edge sigma 0.5), first sensor count (16), in the Tikhonov reconstruction
attempts_before_any_result.exception: ValueError: need at least one array to stack (numpy.stack, called in scripts/mixed_phantom_experiment.py tikhonov, from the reconstruct function of scripts/thin_structure_study.py)
attempts_before_any_result.cause: mixed_phantom_experiment.tikhonov loops over both sensor counts and stacks the recordings of each. The study passes one sensor count at a time, so that both counts see the same phantoms, and the other count's selection was empty. The tests of the plumbing used a stand-in reconstruction and never called the real helper with such a batch.
attempts_before_any_result.in_memory_state: The ten networks had reconstructed the 50 images of that cell at 16 sensors. The arrays were never scored, saved or examined and were discarded when the process ended.
attempts_before_any_result.correction: The commit that adds this record replaces the helper call by a direct call to the same solver for one sensor count (tikhonov_reconstruct): same solver object, same weight, same float32 output, bit-for-bit equal to the helper on a batch with both counts (tests/test_thin_structure_study.py). The configuration, the pre-registration document, the phantom generator and every analysis function are unchanged, which the script verifies against the pre-registration commit before it runs. The results record that commit as execution_commit.
